تعالقت (form VI)
# تَعَالَقْتُ (taʕālaqtu) /ta.ʕaː.laq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# تَعَالَقْتَ (taʕālaqta) /ta.ʕaː.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# تَعَالَقْتِ (taʕālaqti) /ta.ʕaː.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# تَعَالَقَتْ (taʕālaqat) /ta.ʕaː.la.qat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
